free_tier.stated: 1 GB total data+metadata on Free; 10K daily queries; 200M vectors x dimensions

egress.terms: Free (bandwidth price $0 on Free), but 1 GB of stored data makes it moot.

tooling: REST API, Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; vectors are float arrays with up to 48 KB of metadata per vector, 1 MB max data per vector
chaining: 1 GB per database, 100 namespaces per index and 1 index on Free. Namespaces share the 1 GB, so they do not multiply. 500 GB needs 500 free accounts.
limits_note: 1 GB total; 10K queries/day (resets daily); 1 MB max per vector; 48 KB max metadata per vector; 1,536 max dimensions; 100 namespaces; 1 index
reliability_note: Stable managed service; queries are semantically searched rather than key-addressed, so it is a poor fit for blob retrieval anyway — you would use a 1-dimension vector as a pure key-value hack, which still hits the 1 GB cap.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
